slides.heading: Shifted Binary Search
slides.subtitle: AlgoExpert · Hard · Searching
slides.narration: Let's solve Shifted Binary Search, a hard searching problem. We'll restate the problem, build the intuition, walk through the approach, read the Java solution, and finish with its complexity.

slides.heading: The problem
bullets: Find target's index in a sorted array of distinct ints rotated by some amount; -1 if absent.
slides.narration: Here's the problem. Find target's index in a sorted array of distinct ints rotated by some amount; -1 if absent.

slides.heading: Intuition
bullets: In a rotated sorted array, one half is always sorted; check if the target lies in it.
slides.narration: In a rotated sorted array, one half is always sorted; check if the target lies in it.

slides.heading: Brute force vs optimal
bullets: Find the pivot, then binary search → O(log n)
One-pass: identify the sorted half → O(log n)
slides.narration: A linear scan ignores sorting. At every mid, one half is sorted; check if the target lies within that half and discard the other, log n.

slides.heading: Approach
bullets: 3. Check whether the target is in that half
slides.narration: Step by step. First, find the middle. Second, decide which half is sorted. Third, check whether the target is in that half. Fourth, recurse into the right half.

slides.heading: Java solution
slides.narration: While lo is at most hi: return on a match; if the left half is sorted, go left when the target is in its range, else right; otherwise mirror for the right half.

slides.heading: Complexity
slides.narration: Time is O of log n. Space is constant.

slides.heading: Edge cases & pitfalls
bullets: Use ≤ when comparing a[lo] and a[mid]
slides.narration: Use less-or-equal when deciding which half is sorted. Duplicates can force linear time.

slides.heading: Interview tips & follow-ups
slides.narration: With duplicates, worst case degrades to linear.

slides.heading: Recap
bullets: In a rotated sorted array, one half is always sorted; check if the target lies in it.
